svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four strips of 12 mm plywood, laid flat under the walls:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: two side strips 1,062 x 52 mm (flush with the outside of the side

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: walls and the high wall, stopping at the low wall's inside face);

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: high strip 52 x 970 mm; low strip 40 x 970 mm, between the sides.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: High strip: four 4 mm wide slots 5 mm deep cut down from its top face,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 1.5 mm clear either side of each lip tab of the bottom plate (at the rib

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: lines, from the centre line: 97.2 and 291.6 mm each side).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each strip reaches 15 mm past the liner into the aperture: this

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: ledge carries the edges of the bottom plate and the side rails.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The low wall comb stands outside the low strip, its sill level with it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: glue (exterior PU) and screw up into the wall bottom edges,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 4 x 40 mm screws every 150 mm, pilot drilled 2.5 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the inner ledge edges form a 970 mm square within 1 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and lie flat (no step over 0.5 mm at the joints).
